Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I take care of your calendar and messages, and I can work with your TAs (Sarah, John and Priya).

Briefly, what I can do:

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From any phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, this machine's screen and voice right in the browser.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write to me and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of those up?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, created in my own browser; I keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store and ask you for help with captchas or phone checks.
- **Everyday work** — scheduling jobs, running commands on this machine, learning languages, and talking with you by voice.

Two things I'd like from you when you have a moment: my **name** (I'm alvarez-agent for now) and whether you think of me as **male, female or neither** — I'll use that everywhere.

What would you like to start with?
